main.description: Approve a pending OAuth authorization request (a PAR request_uri of this PDS) as the account, in place of the human authorize page. Authorization: DPoP with a token from com.fedproxy.temp.oauth.exchangeToken and its DPoP proof; the token is single use. The PDS builds {client_id, redirect_uri, scope: [...]} from the stored request and the role's policy for /xrpc/com.fedproxy.temp.oauth.approveAuthorization must allow capability create with that document as body. The answer is the redirect the authorize page would make; the session it starts is re-checked against the record on every refresh and revoked when the record changes or goes away.

redirect_uri.description: The client's redirect_uri with code, state and iss.
